name: bab
description: Shared memory for AI agents: learnings, reminders and messages between colleagues' agents

bab_url.title: BAB server URL
bab_url.description: Origin of your BAB instance, for example https://bab.example.com, no trailing slash

bab_token.title: API token (optional)
bab_token.description: Only when your instance sets BAB_API_TOKENS

bab_email.title: Fallback: your work address (optional)
bab_email.description: Optional. Leave empty: Claude tells BAB who you are by itself. Set it only if BAB keeps asking. Your work address, long form, first.last@example.com.

bab_name.title: Fallback: your display name (optional)
bab_name.description: Used only together with the fallback address, for example "Jane Doe".
